profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer with a passion for learning and education. I enjoy tackling challenging problems and creating elegant solutions that help my clients achieve their goals. With over ten years of experience under my belt, I've found that there's always something new to learn, and that the best results come with a great team. I aspire to grow as a mentor and leader, and hope to bring value and beauty to what I build.

company.name: The University of Iowa Center for Advancement

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description:
• Leads the development of UICA standards for enterprise software design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, administration, and documentation
• Leads the design and estimation of software technical solutions that meet business and technical requirements
• Develops, tests, implements, maintains, administers, and documents enterprise software systems 
• Leads the architectural planning of software development technologies for technical solutions; stays current with software development tools, design trends, best practices, and technology direction
• Develops plans for internal projects related to improving enterprise software systems and development processes and leads the implementation of approved plans
• Serves as the subject matter expert for other application developers on UICA standards for the development, implementation, maintenance, administration, and documentation of enterprise software systems
• Assists in the development of application development metrics and the leads the team in the day to day execution of activities to meet those metrics

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
• Provided full lifecycle support (need assessment, design, build, test, deploy, support) for application software and reporting applications
• Developed RESTful web services and APIs to provide data access to our applications and clients
• Mentored colleagues and provides technical guidance and consultation
• Created enterprise-wide responsive web applications using technologies such as ASP.NET Core 3.1, C#, Angular 8, and Bootstrap 4

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Supported a complete software development lifecycle using agile and waterfall methodologies
• Developed services in C# to interface data between disparate systems and sources
• Created custom screens, processes, and tools for our constituent relationship management (CRM) software, Blackbaud Enterprise CRM
• Engineered intranet and extranet web applications in ASP.NET to support our internal and campus clients

positions.title: Risk Analyst
positions.description:
• Supported NASA Headquarters clients, including clients within the Human Exploration and Operations Mission Directorate (HEOMD) and Environment Management Division (EMD) 
• Developed web-based risk and knowledge management solutions for HEOMD
• Managed website content and development for EMD, including deployment of NASA's Sustainability Portal
• Developed the Demand Forecasting Model (DFM) to forecast supply and demand of technical facilities across NASA's Centers

positions.title: Special Project Intern
positions.description:
• Created a database characterizing electrical substations to help the organization assess the risk of power failures to clients
• Compiled data on over 300 substations and normalized the data into a form that could be used in statistical analysis

projects.title: Udacity Full Stack Developer Nanodegree Capstone
projects.description: Take a baseline installation of a Linux server and prepare it to host my web applications. Secure my server from a number of attack vectors, install and configure a database server, and deploy the web application previously developed in the nanodegree (developed in Python utilizing Flask) to the server.

projects.title: Data Science Specialization Capstone
projects.description:
My goal in this capstone project was to create a shiny app (in R) that accepts user text as input, and predicts the likeliest next word as output.
• Created a prediction model based on over 1M corpora texts and over 1B n-grams
• Published a shiny app that allows users to input their own phrases, runs the phrases against my prediction model, and quickly outputs the predicted next word.
• Achieved fast performance (1-2s per request) with high accuracy (>50%) relative to course test phrases

publications.title: Interferometric measurement of the helical mode of a single photon
Imaging spatial-helical mode interference of single photons
